How I work

From business question to action

01 · Understand

Define the business problem, decision context, stakeholders and success metrics.

02 · Validate

Check data quality, structure, missing values, assumptions and limitations.

03 · Analyze

Select the appropriate analytical method: SQL, EDA, statistical testing, BI or machine learning.

04 · Communicate

Translate findings into concise visual stories, KPIs and evidence stakeholders can understand.

05 · Recommend

End every analysis with a practical next step and a way to measure its impact.
